query: Microsoft Azure revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 quarterly results
normalized: 2026 azure fiscal microsoft q3 quarterly results revenue

output.content:
Microsoft reported that **Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 40% year over year** in fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026), or **39% in constant currency**. [[1]] 

Microsoft does **not** disclose a standalone quarterly dollar-revenue figure for Azure; it reports Azure within the broader Intelligent Cloud segment, whose Q3 FY2026 revenue was **$34.7 billion**, up **30%** year over year. [[2]] 

For context, total Microsoft Cloud revenue was **$54.5 billion**, up **29%** year over year, while company-wide revenue was **$82.9 billion**, up **18%**. [[1]]
